title: What Does the Election Commission of India Do? Powers, Limits and the 2026 Court Rulings Explained
seoTitle: Election Commission of India Powers and Functions Explained
seoDescription: Article 324 lets the ECI run Lok Sabha, Assembly, President and VP polls, enforce the poll code and revise voter rolls. Its limits and 2026 SC rulings.
excerpt: A plain guide to the 2023 appointments law and its pending Constitution Bench case, the poll code's legal status, the 2024 VVPAT ruling, the May 2026 SIR judgment, and five things the ECI legally cannot do.
